scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @dexa/contracts && npm run build -w @dexa/common -w @dexa/db -w @dexa/messaging
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dexa/api-gateway -w @dexa/auth-service -w @dexa/employee-service -w @dexa/attendance-service -w @dexa/notification-service -w @dexa/audit-worker
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,employee,attendance,notification,audit,employee-web,admin-web "npm run dev -w @dexa/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @dexa/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @dexa/employee-service" "npm run dev -w @dexa/attendance-service" "npm run dev -w @dexa/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @dexa/audit-worker" "npm run dev -w @dexa/employee-web" "npm run dev -w @dexa/admin-web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:storybook
